contexts.text: Twelve = all things of faith in one complex. AC 577.
Whatever is of the Church, and of the Churches thence derived, in one complex. Signified.
Both living and dead in one complex...
All the regenerate things with man in one complex. Signified.
A genus is the complex of the things thence derived.
Nations meant all the families together in one complex.
Chedorlaomer here stands for all mentioned in , in the complex.
It does not signify the Rational in its complex, but only rational truth.
Honesty is the complex of all the moral virtues.
Everything in one complex through which the Lord is worshipped. Signified.
A book = the Word in the whole complex.
The universal Heaven in one complex relates to one man. General article.
The words are varied in infinite ways according to the series of the things which are in a complex in the thought.
Hell in the whole complex is what is called the devil and satan...
The Natural is from both, and is their complex in the ultimate.
Hence hours, days, etc. = states, and their progressions in series and in the complex.
The Spiritual World is the World of Spirits, Heaven, and Hell, in the complex.
The ultimate degree is the complex, containant, and basis of the prior degrees. General article.
The effect is the complex, etc., of the causes and the ends...
As the ultimate is the complex, it follows that it is also the containant and the basis. DLW 215. DLW 216.
The whole body, which is their complex, makes the third degree.
The sense of the letter is not only the complex...

The universe in its whole complex; the natural world in its complex; the Spiritual World in its; each empire and kingdom in its complex; everything civil, moral, and spiritual of them in its complex; the whole animal, vegetable, and mineral kingdoms, each in its own complex... Man in his complex; every animal, tree, stone, and metal in its own complex.
The greatest Society, which is Heaven in the whole complex...
Like a complex containing nothing.
The Alpha and the Omega = all things in the complex.
The seven Churches = the Church in the whole complex.
The use of marriage love is the complex of all other uses.
The world is a complex of uses in successive order...
Wherefore love is the complex of all goodnesses, and wisdom is the complex of all truths.
Heaven in the complex is the image of God.
As the ten commandments... were in a brief summary the complex of all things of religion... TCR 286.
Hence the decalogue... is a brief complex of the whole Word.
All these together are the name of God in the complex.
Wherefore faith is nothing but the complex of truths shining in the mind of man. TCR 349. TCR 379.
Charity is the complex of all things of good which a man does to the neighbour; and faith is the complex of all things of truth which a man thinks about God and Divine things.
